body.name: Deterministic established-chart selector
body.construction: If \(\mathfrak A^{\mathrm{id}}_{\ell,R}=\varnothing\), set \(\chi_n=\chi_{\star}=d_n=\bot\). For a nonempty atlas, apply the population maximization and fixed tie-break at \(C_{\le R}\) to define \(\chi_{\star}\). If additionally \(n\ge R\), compute \(s_{n,\chi}=|\Delta_{\chi}(\widehat C_{\le R})|/(1+|\Delta_{\chi}(\widehat C_{\le R})|)\), take the first maximizer as \(\chi_n\), and set \(d_n=d_{\chi_n}\); if \(n<R\), set \(\chi_n=d_n=\bot\).
